description.fr-FR: Les exhortations, entretiens et instructions de sainte Jeanne-Françoise de Chantal à ses filles de la Visitation, recueillis par les Sœurs : exhortations en chapitre sur la Règle de saint Augustin et sur les Constitutions, sur divers sujets et pour les fêtes de l’année, soixante-quatorze entretiens, vingt-trois instructions au noviciat, et les Défis donnés aux Sœurs d’Annecy.
description.en-US: The exhortations, conferences and instructions of St. Jane Frances de Chantal to her daughters of the Visitation, gathered by the Sisters: chapter exhortations on the Rule of St. Augustine and the Constitutions, on various subjects and for the feasts of the year, seventy-four conferences, twenty-three instructions to the novitiate, and the Défis given to the Sisters of Annecy.
description.pt-BR: As exortações, conversas e instruções de santa Joana Francisca de Chantal às suas filhas da Visitação, recolhidas pelas Irmãs: exortações no capítulo sobre a Regra de santo Agostinho e as Constituições, sobre assuntos diversos e para as festas do ano, setenta e quatro conversas, vinte e três instruções ao noviciado e os Défis dados às Irmãs de Annecy.

fr-FR.editor: Religieuses du Premier Monastère de la Visitation d’Annecy

sources.edition: Sainte Jeanne-Françoise Frémyot de Chantal, sa vie et ses œuvres, Plon, Paris, 1875, tome II (Œuvres diverses I), pp. 73–579. Archive.org OCR of the Sainte-Geneviève copy.
sources.description: OCR cleaned by script. These are reports (reportationes) written down by her daughters, as with Francis de Sales’s Entretiens. The first part of the volume (Petit livret, questions and answers, Papiers intimes) is a separate book.
